title: Hero: a serif title in two lines (the second at weight 300), a mono date label, a sans deck, two pill buttons and a seeded tile grid on the right
use: The first screen of a data explorer or an index report; the grid is a decoration seeded by --param seed.

theme.note: light (ivory #FAF9F5) or dark (#141413) ground; tile names and the tooltip keep their fixed inks

convention.note: intl (default, the measured lineage): green heat scale, rising green, falling coral; cn (红涨绿跌, Chinese markets): red heat scale from light to deep, rising red, falling green; the tile grid and the mark's dots follow it

seed.note: seeds the tile values, so the grid's colours

deck.default: 按地区与板块，看关注度比按成交占比的预期高出多少。示例数据，仅用于展示版式。

relations: Title 80 units serif, the second line weight 300, a 92 pitch (the page's 80 / 88); the mono label 14 uppercase-style with 4% tracking; deck 20 sans #5E5D59 in a 600-unit column.
The grid is 8 x 8 cells of 70 on a 76 pitch, right-aligned to 1504, centred vertically; copy keeps to the left 880 units.
decoration: The tile grid, the graph-paper mark with four dots and its hairlines are decoration.

provenance.corpus: market hotspot index explorer kit (examples/index-explorer-kit): our own original data page in the index-explorer grammar; every number is generated in the page and marked as sample data
provenance.experiment: styles/index-explorer/style.json provenance (two public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The data page's hero re-set: a two-line serif title over a mono date label with the page's tile-grid colours as the picture.
measured: Hero 80 / 88 serif, the second line weight 300; date label mono 13 uppercase #5E5D59; a small graph-paper mark with green dots above the title.
Template: seeded grid, light and dark pass.
